promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-04 (nyiso-125). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-04-nyiso-125-seam-envelope (bundle results/calibration/nyiso125_seam_A), superseding 2026-08-04-nyiso-120-c119-scope. DETERMINATION LABEL IS UNCHANGED AT NOT-YET and the substance is BETTER, both re-verified without a solve (scripts/calibration_verdict.py --run-id, committed artifacts only, rule 22 D-5(b)). WHAT IT DOES: arms nyiso_seam_deliverability_envelope, a rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] INPUT correction with ZERO free parameters and ZERO new numbers -- the two border links whose external ties land unambiguously in ONE NYISO load zone (NYC = Zone J: HTP + Linden VFT; Long_Island = Zone K: Neptune + Cross Sound + Northport-Norwalk 1385) trade their flat SYMMETRIC time-invariant static rating for NYISO's OWN measured DIRECTIONAL HOURLY deliverability envelope off the MIS P-32 posting (p90 of the directionally-clipped net schedule within each month x hour-of-day bin). It answers the successor question nyiso-124 section 6.1 handed this lane. THE REFUSAL IS AS LOAD-BEARING AS THE CONSTRUCTION. Phase 0 identified the envelope EXACTLY on those two links (attribution-invariant, zero freedom) and REFUSED IT on Capital_Hudson and Upstate_West: SCH - PJ - NY is the one posting row spanning the Central-East cutset (Ramapo/Waldwick into Zone G east; Homer City-Stolle Road/Falconer into Zone A west), NEITHER NYISO's P-32 NOR PJM's own tie file separates the legs, and the split brackets Capital_Hudson's import envelope across 45-955 / 0-916 / 0-1,134 MW in 2023/24/25 -- the whole range that matters, on the link carrying the defect. Those two links KEEP THEIR STATICS. Two further Phase-0 verdicts, measured and neither armed: the POSTED-LIMIT envelope (the stronger rule 13 object, fully identified) is REFUTED -- the three AC seams reach 95 % of their posted import limit in 0.0-0.1 % of hours in EVERY year and a posted-limit cap would LOOSEN exactly the links that over-deliver; and the split-INVARIANT joint cap is identified and PROVABLY INERT. THE EX-ANTE PREDICTION IS CONFIRMED IN ALL THREE YEARS AND OVERSHOOTS IN NONE. PREREG section 4.2 predicted before solving that Capital_Hudson, already at its bound in ~100 % of hours, cannot absorb the displaced MW, so the 307/406/369 MW removed downstate must arrive at Upstate_West and reach load through Central East, closing ~30-40 % of the CE utilisation gap. Measured: CE util p50 0.467/0.197/0.255 -> 0.668/0.335/0.383 against a MEASURED 0.807/0.616/0.591, i.e. +59.1/+33.0/+38.0 % of the gap closed, 2025 landing dead centre of the pre-registered band. (The measured CE utilisation is read PER YEAR from NYISO's own posting; nyiso-124's 0.591 is the 2025 value and using it for 2023 would misstate that gap ~2.4x -- corrected, not carried.) THE TRADE, against its own same-HEAD control 2026-08-04-nyiso-125-control (which reproduces the nyiso-120 keeper's C3a EXACTLY at +7.2/-0.9/-10.1 %, model $34.64 in 2023): ALL SIX pre-registered kill gates SILENT (K1 largest zone-mean move +5.76 %; K2 ZERO new unserved energy; K3 C1 does not regress; K4 LIVE not inert, max zonal |dLMP| $265.93/$106.21/$104.79; K5 four-link seam NET moves only +31/-98/+90 MW p50 so the monthly EIA-930 reconciliation band holds; K6 control reproduces the keeper). C3c THE LEDGERED CAVEAT IMPROVES MATERIALLY: raw tail hours 3/0/14 -> 18/2/21 against actual 10/12/42, so on identical scoring the tail gate goes from FAILING ALL THREE YEARS to failing 2024 alone (2023 and 2025 PASS). REPORTED AGAINST INTEREST: 2023 now OVERSHOOTS at 1.80x (18 h vs 10 h actual) -- inside the band but over-produced, and named as an open item; and C3a-2025 moves -10.1 % -> -10.2 %, marginally WORSE, so the C3a FAIL is NOT closed and is not softened here. C3a 2023 +7.2 -> +7.7 % and 2024 -0.9 -> -0.8 %, both still PASS -- the pre-registered adverse case (2023 crossing +10 %) did NOT materialise. C1/C2/C3b/C4/C6/C7/C8 all PASS in both arms; D-1/D-2/D-4/D-5/D-9/D-10 all PASS. PROMOTION RESTS ON RULE 1 [R-STRUCT] / RULE 14 [R-ACCURATE], NOT ON A SCORE, and the owner ruled in advance that structural gain may outweigh a gate regression -- recorded in PREREG section 8 BEFORE any result existed. DOF ledger 33 -> 34 entries, n_residual UNCHANGED at 6: the caps are a percentile of NYISO's own measured schedules under the repo-wide DEFINITIONAL convention (MISO_SEAM_FLOW_PERCENTILE == PJM_SEAM_FLOW_PERCENTILE == 90.0, pre-registered never-swept), the tie attribution is an identity with no choice in it, and the half that WOULD have needed a chosen number was refused rather than estimated. nyiso-100's SIL retirement is NOT re-opened and no aggregate cap is introduced. Both arms commit hourly/network_<year>.parquet with git add -f, which also DISCHARGES nyiso-124's one provenance caveat: the control independently reproduces its seam diagnosis on the CURRENT keeper recipe (external>Upstate_West p50 -998/-1,520/-1,702 MW vs nyiso-124's -1,003/-1,520/-1,689). frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
